descriptions.capabilities: Local documentation search across many files. BM25 ranks sections by keyword relevance and returns source paths, exact line ranges, and matching snippets. Supports unfamiliar wording and queries spanning several concepts; exact-string search remains available through rg.
descriptions.unix: A composable Unix search command for local text. rankgrep QUERY PATH... emits ranked JSONL with paths and line ranges; -k controls result count, --files-from - accepts a file list on stdin, and ordinary exit codes support shell pipelines. Works alongside rg, find, sed, and scripts.
descriptions.output: Ranked evidence lookup in local documentation and source text. Each JSONL result contains path, start, end, score, a matching snippet, and matched query terms. Keyword retrieval with BM25, automatic cached indexing, and no model calls or embeddings.

cache_policy: Private session copy of phase-A topic cache; native installed launcher warmed before timing.
